title: Ferlab-Ste-Justine/cnv-post-processing pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

familyId.errorMessage: familyId must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

caller.errorMessage: caller must identify the tool that produced the CNV VCF (e.g. 'DRAGEN'). Only 'DRAGEN' and 'DRAGEN_JOINT' are currently supported by the normalization step. 'DRAGEN_JOINT' means 'vcf' is a DRAGEN jointly-called, family-level, multi-sample VCF (not a per-sample one) -- a family using it must have exactly one row, and cannot also have per-sample rows.

vcf.errorMessage: VCF file containing CNV calls must be provided and have a '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz' extension. For caller='DRAGEN_JOINT', this is the family's jointly-called, multi-sample VCF rather than a per-sample one.

cram.errorMessage: Alignment file, if provided, must have a '.cram' or '.bam' extension. Required for the depth-based genotype-refinement step; samples without it skip that step. Not used for caller='DRAGEN_JOINT' rows -- joint calling doesn't have the post-hoc-merge missing-genotype problem that step exists to work around, so it's always skipped for those families.

pheno.errorMessage: Per-sample phenopacket file, if provided, must have a '.yml', '.yaml', or '.json' extension. Required for exomiser (single-sample mode); samples without it skip that step.

familyPheno.errorMessage: Phenopacket file, if provided, must have a '.yml', '.yaml', or '.json' extension and be identical across all rows of the same family. Required for exomiser (family mode); families without it skip that step.

familyPed.errorMessage: PED file, if provided, must have a '.ped' extension and be identical across all rows of the same family. Required for the mendelian2 QC and slivar inheritance steps; families without it skip those steps.
